en.headline: Police hunt former domestic helper after HK$600,000 jewellery theft in Mid-Levels
en.dek: A 56-year-old woman reported necklaces, bracelets and rings missing from her Robinson Road flat on Sunday evening; police are seeking a 37-year-old former helper who held a Hong Kong identity card.
body: Police are seeking a former domestic helper after a resident reported jewellery worth about HK$600,000 stolen from a flat on Robinson Road in Mid-Levels.
A 56-year-old woman surnamed Lee reported the theft to police around 6pm on Sunday. She said a batch of jewellery, including necklaces, bracelets and rings, had disappeared from the flat.
According to police information cited by local media, the case has been classified as theft and is being followed by the Central District Crime Squad Team 3. No one has been arrested so far.
Investigators are looking for a 37-year-old woman holding a Hong Kong identity card, described as a Filipino national who previously worked as a helper at the flat and left the post in mid-October.

zh.headline: 半山羅便臣道單位失竊約60萬元首飾 警追紗37歲前外傭
zh.dek: 56歲女戶主周日傍晚報案指羅便臣道單位內頸鏈、手鏈及戒指等首飾失蹤，警方正追紗一名37歲持香港身份證的前菲律賓籍外傭。
body: 中區半山羅便臣道一單位發生盜竊案，一批約值60萬港元的首飾失蹤，警方正追紗一名前外傭。
一名56歲姓李女子於周日傍晚近6時向警方報案，指發現單位內一批首飾不翼而飛，包括頸鏈、手鏈及戒指等。
警方初步調查後將案件列作盜竊，交由中區警區刑事調查隊第三隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
警方正追紗一名37歲持香港身份證的菲律賓女子，據悉她曾在上址擔任傭人，並於十月中離職。
